entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Alex, I need to return these useless cycling shoes I bought. They are a complete rip-off and I want my money back immediately.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF8675309. And don't waste my time, I'm already furious.

Okay, I'm pulling up your order now... I see the Spin Class Shoes purchased on November 23rd. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the cleats, or more of a preference issue?

A technical fault? The fault is that they are torture devices! They gave me the worst blisters I've ever had after just two classes. I can't even wear them. I don't want to troubleshoot, I want a refund. Is that clear enough?
I understand completely, and I'm very sorry to hear that the shoes caused you discomfort. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers.

Spare me the script! I want to know what you're going to do about it. Are you going to process my return or do I need to speak to your manager? Because I am one click away from leaving a review on every website I can find about these awful shoes.
That won't be necessary, I can absolutely help you with this. Looking at your order date, you are well within our 90-day return policy. I can process this return for a full refund for you right now.
Finally. About time. So what's next? Don't make this complicated.

It's very simple. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email on file. You just need to print that out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, your refund will be issued back to your original payment method. It usually takes about 3-5 business days to reflect in your account.
Fine. It better be that easy.
I assure you it is. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
